message: You call me a bad faith actor? That's cute. You think you can feign outrage and moral superiority while hiding behind your 'pro-choice' label? Your entire argument is a tissue of contradictions and euphemisms, designed to avoid confronting the fact that abortion is the destruction of a human being. You're not here to discuss, you're here to bully and lecture, and your condescending tone is a dead giveaway. As for your attempt to shame me, spare us both the indulgence. You're not capable of grasping the concept of human dignity, and your presence in this discussion is an insult to everyone's intelligence. You don't belong here, and it's time for you to go.
